title: Record form
summary: The page layout of a create-or-edit record around your own form: a toolbar (Cancel, your actions, Delete, Save), optional tabs, an error alert, the form in a pk-form (a summary of the problems, focus on the first, live checks), and an optional sidebar of status cards beside it (pk-detail-layout, one column on a phone). It owns no values, no load and no save: put your own <form> (and its fields) in the default slot, listen for pk-record-save when it validates, and keep the state yourself. Save submits your form, so pk-form checks it first. With actions-in-header the toolbar row is left out and a Save button in the page header calls submit() instead. On a phone the toolbar buttons fold to their icons (the words stay their names).

props.name: saveLabel
props.description: The Save button's text. Change it only for a page whose submit is an action ("Record payout").

props.name: busyText
props.description: The Save button's text while busy.

props.name: saveDisabled
props.description: Disables Save (a locked record, or nothing to save yet). Independent of busy.

props.name: busy
props.description: Save shows its busy state and Delete is disabled while the page saves or deletes.

props.name: error
props.description: A message shown in an error alert above the form; empty shows none.

props.name: cancellable
props.description: Shows a Cancel button first in the toolbar (pk-record-cancel).

props.name: deletable
props.description: Shows a Delete button (warn variant, disabled while busy) before Save (pk-record-delete).

props.name: tabsFrom
props.description: Where the tabs in the tabs slot take effect. An element in the form or the sidebar with a tab attribute (a tab value, or several separated by spaces) belongs to those tabs: at or below the width named (phone, tablet), or always, only the chosen tab's sections show and the strip is visible; above it every section shows (the two-column layout) and the strip is hidden. Sections with no tab attribute always show. The element sets hidden on the tagged sections.

props.name: actionsInHeader
props.description: Leaves the toolbar row out so the buttons can sit in the page's own header and stay visible in its sticky title bar. Put your own Save button in the header and have it call submit() (a form attribute cannot cross this element's shadow root).

slots.description: Your own form element, with its fields. pk-form wraps it.

slots.name: sidebar
slots.description: Status and flag cards beside the form (pk-detail-layout). Left empty, the form takes the whole width.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Extra toolbar buttons, between Cancel and Delete.

slots.name: tabs
slots.description: A pk-tabs strip for a record with more than one job, under the toolbar. Tag sections with a tab attribute (see tabs-from) and the chosen tab shows its sections, or render the chosen tab's content yourself.

events.name: pk-record-save
events.description: Save was pressed (or submit() called, or the form submitted) and pk-form found the form valid: save the record. An invalid form raises no event; pk-form shows the problems.

parts.name: shell
parts.description: The column: toolbar, tabs, error, then the layout.

parts.name: toolbar
parts.description: The row of buttons (left out with actions-in-header).

parts.name: tabs
parts.description: The row holding the tabs slot; hidden when there are no tabs or tabs-from says they do not apply at this width.

parts.name: layout
parts.description: The pk-detail-layout holding the form and the sidebar.

writes.target: elements with a tab attribute in the form and the sidebar
writes.why: A section tagged with a tab is hidden while another tab is chosen and tabs apply (tabs-from), and shown again when they stop applying.

a11y: The buttons are real pk-buttons with their own names; Save is the form's submit, so Enter in a field submits as usual. pk-form's summary (role=alert) lists every problem with links that focus the field, and focuses the first invalid control. The error alert uses pk-alert's own role. Without a sidebar the page is one column; the sidebar follows the form in reading order.

examples.title: A record with a sidebar, Cancel and Delete (your own form in the default slot)
examples.html:
<pk-record-form cancellable deletable>
  <form>
    <pk-stack>
      <pk-field label="Name" required><pk-input name="name" required></pk-input></pk-field>
      <pk-field label="Notes"><pk-textarea name="notes"></pk-textarea></pk-field>
    </pk-stack>
  </form>
  <pk-card slot="sidebar" heading="Status"><pk-badge variant="ok">Active</pk-badge></pk-card>
</pk-record-form>

methods.name: submit()
methods.description: Submits your form as its own submit button would: pk-form checks it, and a valid one raises pk-record-save. Call it from a button outside this element.
